verdict.rationale: dlt is code-first. Pipelines are built and run in Python (dlt-docs-29, dlt-docs-50), and a user confirms they can do everything via code (dlt-comm-11). For the dltHub platform, the docs say the CLI and the Web UI both cover monitoring, logs, and diagnosis (dlt-docs-15); deploy, schedule, and backfill run through the CLI and Python API (dlt-docs-11); and an MCP server manages pipelines, secrets, schemas, and runs (dlt-docs-72). However, no published REST/OpenAPI surface was found (dlt-probe-3), and nothing states full UI-to-API parity. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement of UI/API parity, a public REST/OpenAPI API for dltHub platform operations, and independent confirmation that every Web UI action has a programmatic equivalent.
